look: Blood Opal Siren, a C-rank GKOM variant from the Opal Sirens family: beautiful winged siren with a glowing blood-opal heart, flowing modest robes. Family anatomy: winged women-shaped sirens and harpies with opal-feathered wings and taloned feet. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystal plates over shoulders, back and limbs; about a third of the body crystallised; the crystals are blood-red opal. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, clear ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
